description: This source file contains the implementation of the ConvertTree class, which provides services to convert the output of the DOS 'tree' command into a content hierarchy within the OFBiz framework. It defines methods to process a textual representation of directory trees, create corresponding Content and ContentAssoc entities, and establish parent-child relationships in the content tree.

classes.name: ConvertTree
classes.description: A utility class in OFBiz to convert DOS 'tree' command output into a content hierarchy within the OFBiz framework, providing services for creating Content and ContentAssoc entities based on directory structures.

methods.name: convertTree
methods.description: Main method to read a tree structure from a file, parse it, and build a corresponding content hierarchy in OFBiz. It initializes root content, reads the input line by line, and creates content and associations accordingly.

methods.name: createSubContent
methods.description: Helper method invoked to process sub-contents (subdirectories or files) at a specific position in a line, creating Content and ContentAssoc entries for each sub-item.
